totals.households_note: Unavailable: intervention-area livelihood beneficiaries require a field-tested employment/adoption model; exposed cell population is not a household count.

optimality.note: Upper bound ignores per-cell overlap capping, so the true gap is smaller.

robustness.interpretation: Measures selected by both expected-value and CVaR objectives are robust to the choice of portfolio objective under the stated Monte-Carlo scenarios.

provenance.data_status: counterfactual simulation — deterministic candidate suitability plus literature-based intervention effects; field verification required
provenance.method: marginal greedy triple-return/$ with per-cell EAL capping over 160 Monte-Carlo hazard scenarios; climate multiplier sigma=0.475 from GEV 100-yr CI; objective=expected

factors.source: Vetiver hedgerows cut slope erosion >90% (Truong et al.); cost/income from ICIMOD bioengineering field costings.
Bamboo root reinforcement for shallow landslides; bamboo is an established Nepali rural cash crop (INBAR).
NbS flood-depth reduction ~15-40% (UNEP); floodplain reconnection costs from World Bank NbS catalogue.
Wetland attenuation of peak flows; high soil-carbon uptake (Ramsar / IPCC wetlands supplement).
Catchment afforestation for slope stability and infiltration; sequestration from IPCC AFOLU defaults.
Bioengineered riverbank protection (live crib walls, brush layering) per ICIMOD/DSCWM manuals.
